serverInfo.name: io.github.vbhjckfd/timetable-api-node
serverInfo.title: Lviv Public Transport
serverInfo.description: Read-only access to Lviv, Ukraine public transport: live stop arrivals, trip planning (direct or one transfer), stop search by name or location, route stops and timetables, live vehicle positions and headways, and announced detours and closures. Sourced from municipal GTFS and GTFS-RT. No API key, OAuth, or user configuration is required.
